title: Non-staff admin access test never authenticates the intended user
reasoning: The regular user is created with username regular@example.com, but the test logs in with username regular. The expected redirect can therefore be caused by a failed login rather than by an authenticated non-staff user being denied admin access. This leaves the actual permission boundary under-tested.
recommendation: Log in using the created user's real username and assert login succeeds before requesting the admin changelist.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The test checks only the final redirect and does not verify that the regular user was authenticated.
suggestedRegressionTest: Change the login to username='regular@example.com', assert it returns True, then assert the admin page is denied for the authenticated non-staff user.
minimumFixScope: Correct the credentials and add an authentication assertion in test_admin_list_view_requires_staff.
